HEADQUARTERS CRIME BRANCH
D. C. (Special Branch)
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. REGISTRY / No. S. B. D. ____ / Station ____ / Date January 31st 39）

Subject Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie.

Made by J. A. Rhodes Forwarded by C. D. I. Grubb

Sir,

At 10.30 a.m. on January 31st. 1939, Sergeant Tomiki attached to the Special Branch of the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters came to the S.M.P. office and requested assistance to visit the Sung Yih (盛義) rice shop, No.63 Seymour Road to verify statements made by two persons who had been arrested in Nanking in possession of radio parts.

It was ascertained that the two men they had in custody were named:-
(1) Sau Wei Ling (趙維新), 26, Shanghai,
(2) Sau Tsung Nyoch (曹振源), 23, Shanghai,
and were arrested in room No.16 Dah Hwa Lodging House, Yoong K., Nanking on January 11th. 1939 in possession of some old radio parts, during interrogation they had stated that they were employed at No.63 Seymour Road.

The discovery of the radio accessories led the Japanese to believe that the two persons may be communicating with geurrillas or other anti-Japanese organizations.

Assistance was rendered by D.S. Rhodes, J.D.S.s 132, 111 and C.J.S. 35 and the rice shop, No.63 Seymour Road was visited.

From the occupants it was ascertained that both of the arrested men had been employed thereat for 10 years and 16 years respectively, and that on January 8th. 1939 they left Shanghai for Nanking to buy rice for the shop.

Regarding the radio parts it appears that both men are in the habit of buying spare parts and assembling and repairing radios in their spare time.

No arrests or search made.

C. Rhodes.
D.S. 114

总部犯罪科
D. C.（特务科）
上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 档案号 登记处 / 编号 S. B. D. ____ / 警署 ____ / 日期 1939年1月31日）

事由：协助日本宪兵队。

呈报人：J. A. Rhodes 转呈人：C. D. I. Grubb

先生，

1939年1月31日上午10时30分，隶属于日本宪兵队总部特务科的Tomiki巡长来到本警务处办公室，请求协助前往西摩路63号盛義米店，以核实两名在南京被捕时持有无线电零件的人员所作的供词。

经查，被其拘留的两名男子姓名为：
(1) 赵维新 (Sau Wei Ling)，26岁，上海人，
(2) 曹振源 (Sau Tsung Nyoch)，23岁，上海人，
两人于1939年1月11日在南京永康路大华旅社16号房间因持有一些旧无线电零件而被捕，在审讯期间，他们声称受雇于西摩路63号。

发现无线电配件使日本人相信，这两人可能与游击队或其他反日组织有联络。

由警佐Rhodes、初级警佐132号、111号及华籍初级警佐35号提供协助，并对西摩路63号米店进行了走访。

据店内人员称，两名被捕者分别已在此受雇10年和16年，且于1939年1月8日离开上海前往南京为店铺采购大米。

关于无线电零件，看来两人均有在业余时间购买备件、组装和修理收音机的习惯。

未实施逮捕或搜查。

C. Rhodes.
警佐 114号

35/39
Mar 8th 39

D.C. Special Branch
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. __________
Col. C.D.H.Q. Station, __________
REPORT
Date March 12th 1939

Subject FURTHER TO ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE MILITARY POLICE : ARREST OF TWO
MALE CHINESE.

Made by D.S. FOWLER Forwarded by C.D.I. GRUBB.

Sir,

The Japanese Military Police, complying with the
conditions re the temporary handing over to their custody of
the two males

1) Mou Tsoh Ching ( 馬絲筠 )
2) Tseu Yoh Voong ( 周毓文 ) alias
Loh Tsung Jeu ( 陸振球 )

on the 8th March, returned them to C.B.H.Q. per Sgt. Major
Katoda through the S.P.O., at 6 p.m. on the 11th inst.

Sgt. Major Katoda verbally requested that the
two males be permanently handed over to the Japanese Military
Police at an early date.

They are meanwhile being detained in the cells
at Central Station. Statements are being taken from them.

（签名）
D.S. 329.

（手写批注：13/3）
（手写批注：P.A. 13/3）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 ___
中央巡捕房总部，___
报告
日期 1939年3月12日

事由：续报协助日本军警事宜：逮捕两名中国男性。

呈报人：警佐 FOWLER 转呈人：C.D.I. GRUBB。

先生，

日本军警依照将两名男性临时移交其拘留的条件，

1) 马丝筠 (Mou Tsoh Ching)
2) 周毓文 (Tseu Yoh Voong)，别名
陆振球 (Loh Tsung Jeu)

于3月8日接收后，于本月11日下午6时通过特别警察办事处（S.P.O.），由Katoda警长将其交还至中央巡捕房总部（C.B.H.Q.）。

Katoda警长口头要求尽早将这两名男性永久移交给日本军警。

目前他们被拘留在中央巡捕房的牢房内。正在对他们进行录供。

（签名）
警佐 329号。

（手写批注：13/3）
（手写批注：P.A. 13/3）

Date .................... 19 .........

O.C. Special Branch.
S.H.D. 8299/31
March 11, 3 39

FURTHER REPORT TO J. M. S. M. POLICE IN CONNECTION WITH THE
ARREST OF TONG YUE LAU (董岳合).

J. J. Bradley                                     C.D.I. Grubb.

Sir,

On the afternoon of 10.3.39 D.S.I. Umemoto, attached to
the S.P.O. reported that the Japanese Military Police re-
quested assistance to arrest a male Chinese alleged to be
an accomplice of TSOU YUN WEN (周云文), who was arrested
on March 8, 1939, at Lane 642/3 Chengtu Road. The assistance
was required at 6 p.m. 11.3.39 and arrangements were made
accordingly.

As the raid was to take place in the U. S. Marine Corps
sector, it was also arranged that officers of that Corps
should be present when the raid was carried out.

At 6 p.m. 11.3.39 the Japanese Military Police under
Sgt. Major Satoda brought Tsou Yun Wen (周云文) to C.B.H.Q.
and the prisoner was interrogated by C.D.I. Grubb regarding
his accomplice and the following was ascertained.

About 3 months prior to this date, the prisoner was
in Yangzhou and he met a male Chinese named TONG YUE LAU
(董岳合), about 50 years old whom he knew to be engaged
in guerilla warfare against the Japanese in the capacity
of propaganda chief.

When the prisoner left Yangzhou for Shanghai he was
informed by Tong Yue Lau that if he wished to communicate
with him he should write a letter to House 3, Lane 753
Shanghaiwan Road.

Since arriving in Shanghai the prisoner has never
encountered Tong Yue Lau and he has never communicated with
him, therefore he was not sure whether or not Tong would be
at the address given.

At about 6.25 p.m. the prisoner had finished his statement

（左侧印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / SPECIAL BRANCH / 11.3.39）
（左侧手写批注：S.I. / J.R. / 12/3 / east side / 88 / 14/3 / 1000/3）

总部犯罪科
C. I. 机密档案
编号 / 25/39
日期 ____ 19 ____ 

特务科主管。
S.H.D. 8299/31
1939年3月11日

续报关于董岳合 (TONG YUE LAU) 被捕一事与日本军警之联系。

J. J. Bradley                                     C.D.I. Grubb.

先生，

1939年3月10日下午，隶属于特别警察办事处（S.P.O.）的Umemoto高级警佐报告称，日本军警请求协助逮捕一名中国男性，据称其为1939年3月8日在成都路642/3弄被捕的周云文 (TSOU YUN WEN) 的同伙。所需协助时间为1939年3月11日下午6时，并已据此作出安排。

由于突袭行动将在美国海军陆战队防区内进行，因此也安排了在该行动执行时由该部队军官在场。

1939年3月11日下午6时，日本军警在Satoda警长带领下将周云文 (Tsou Yun Wen) 带至中央巡捕房总部（C.B.H.Q.），由C.D.I. Grubb就该犯的同伙问题进行审讯，并查明以下情况。

约三个月前，该犯在扬州，结识了一名名叫董岳合 (TONG YUE LAU) 的中国男性，年龄约50岁，据其所知，此人担任宣传主任，从事针对日本的游击战活动。

当该犯离开扬州前往上海时，董岳合告知他，若欲与其联络，应写信至上海湾路753弄3号。

自抵达上海以来，该犯从未遇到过董岳合，也从未与其联络，因此他不确定董是否会在上述地址。

约下午6时25分，该犯完成供词

（左侧印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 特务科 / 1939年3月11日）
（左侧手写批注：S.I. / J.R. / 12/3 / 东区 / 88 / 14/3 / 1000/3）

- 2 -

but the U. S. Marine Corps officers had not arrived, therefore
C.D.I. Grubb communicated with the B.C. Crime Branch, who
gave permission for the raid to be carried out in their
absence.

At about 6.40 a.m. the raid was carried out at the
given address which is a large sized Chinese dwelling
house occupied by four different tenants, but no evidence
was found that any person named Tong Yue was a resident there.

All the rooms in the house were entered and looked over
and a cursory search of the room of Ling S Ven (凌子文),
Cotton Broker, revealed no evidence that would suggest that
the premises were used for the purpose of being a communication
centre for guerilla activities, as stated by the prisoner.

At about 7 a.m. the party left the premises without
making any arrests or seizing any goods.

Sinza Station was informed that the raid had been
carried out.

The Japanese Military Police state that Tseu Yoh
Voong has admitted being a guerilla unit organiser in
Shanghai.

J Bradley.
3. 244.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

但美国海军陆战队军官尚未到达，因此C.D.I. Grubb与BC区（西区）犯罪科联系，后者许可在其不在场的情况下执行突袭行动。

约上午6时40分，在指定地址执行了突袭行动，该处为一幢大型中式住宅，由四户不同租客居住，但未发现任何名为Tong Yue的人居住于此的证据。

屋内所有房间均进入并查看，对棉花经纪人凌子文 (Ling S Ven) 的房间进行了粗略搜查，未发现任何证据表明该处所被用作囚犯所述的游击活动联络中心。

约上午7时，行动小组离开该处所，未实施逮捕或扣押任何物品。

已通知辛扎警署（Sinza Station）突袭行动已执行。

日本军警称，周毓文 (Tseu Yoh Voong) 已承认其在上海担任游击队组织者。

J Bradley.
3. 244.
